items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this for a premium documentary YouTube Shorts channel about money, history and the tricks behind them. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller with a hint of mystery: curious, quietly amused, energetic and punchy, never slow, never announcer-like. Natural emphasis on dates and numbers, questions end with a curious lift, a short comic pause before each punchline. Keep the same voice, pace and energy from start to finish. Chars voices two funny cartoon characters (a smug gold bar and a nervous banknote), short and punchy, performed exactly as described in each bracket.
lines: You lost five thousand dollars to a scam. Then the F.B.I. calls. They can get it back, for a fee. Do you pay?
The agent sounds real. The badge on video looks real. He even knows you were scammed.
Just a small recovery fee. Upfront.
[nervous, squeaky, high-pitched banknote, worried] Oh no. Not again.
So how does a stranger know about your loss?
The F.T.C. says scammers buy lists of people who've already been scammed. You're on a list.
And that's not even the boldest part.
The F.B.I. warns of deepfake videos of a real F.B.I. leader, sending victims to a fake complaint site.
The real I.C.3 never calls you first, and never charges a fee to get money back. Zero.
[smug, deep, rich, self-satisfied] Same victim, twice. How efficient.
Comment: would you have paid the fee?
This is Money Mirage. Follow for more.
